title: Trump admin speaking 'DIRECTLY' with Iran's 'HARDLINE' IRGC officials
text:
Trump admin speaking 'DIRECTLY' with Iran's 'HARDLINE' IRGC officials"
"👇 👇 👇 "

"💥  IRGC Dismisses Trump's Claim of Back-Channel Talks as 'Delusions Born of Defeat'"

"TEHRAN (Tasnim News Agency) – Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on Monday vehemently denied former U.S. President Donald Trump’s claim that Washington is holding back‑channel negotiations with IRGC officials, characterizing the allegation as a baseless lie stemming from psychological defeat."

"Brigadier General Hossein Mohbi, the IRGC spokesman, told Tasnim that "no negotiations are taking place between IRGC commanders and Americans," dismissing Trump's remarks as "pure fantasy driven by delusions and nightmares stemming from his defeat and desperation in the war.""

"General Mohbi clarified that the IRGC serves as the armed fist and voice of Iran's national strength, making its statements on the battlefield, while diplomatic matters remain under the purview of other branches of the Islamic Republic. He underscored that, based on emphatic statements from the Foreign Ministry, no diplomatic talks with the U.S. are currently underway given Washington's "dark history of repeatedly reneging on its commitments.""

"The spokesman further accused Trump of attempting to artificially influence global oil and energy prices through his remarks. He stressed that the former president's "mental fantasies will not help him on the ground," and issued a stark ultimatum to American officials: "accept defeat and comply with the terms set by Iran." General Mohbi warned that the sooner U.S. leaders acknowledge their failure, the sooner they can prevent their country from suffering even greater losses.
